name: Frog Innovations Ltd.
summary: Frog Innovations Ltd. is a company that specializes in the production of telecommunications infrastructure hardware. Their comprehensive product line features multi-band digital radio frequency (RF) repeaters compatible with 2G, 3G, and 4G networks, alongside multi-band frequency shifting repeaters and multi-band optical distributed antenna systems (DAS). The company also supplies ancillary software and various accessories to complement these systems. In addition to manufacturing, Frog Innovations offers expert services, which include the strategic planning and design of in-building coverage solutions, as well as the complete installation of both radio access networks (RAN) and backhaul networks. The organization commenced operations on July 12, 2004, and maintains its principal office in Noida, India.
